component.name: PiMusicPlayerTray
component.summary: Control MusicPlayerV2 from the system tray

description.p: PiMusicPlayerTray shows a system tray icon with the currently playing track from a MusicPlayerV2 instance, and registers global keyboard shortcuts to play/pause, stop, skip, and change the volume without having to switch to the browser tab. This is the Linux counterpart of the original Windows PiMusicPlayerTray application.
Initial Linux release of PiMusicPlayerTray, packaged as a Flatpak.
